title: Cut-off estimate for f·L^*(dy¹∧…∧dyⁿ) given the pullback bound (H1) and cut-offs (H2) with b = 1 on L(K): |T(f·θ_L)| ≤ c·c'·μ(W∖K) (Step 7 of the parent proof; Simon 6, proof of Lemma 2.36, display (2))
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, and U, W, K ⊆ ℝ^P with W open, W ⊆ U and K compact. Let T ∈ D_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), μ a measure on ℝ^P and ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) with IsMeasureRepresentation T μ ξ (for every ω ∈ Dⁿ(U), x ↦ ξ(x)(ω(x)) is μ-integrable and T(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x)), and assume μ(W∖K) ≠ ∞. Let L : ℝ^P → ℝⁿ be a continuous linear map and θ_L := wedgeCovectors n (fun i => y^i∘L) ∈ Covector (Eucl P) n, where y^i = EuclideanSpace.proj i are the coordinate functions on ℝⁿ. Let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞)) with compact support and tsupport f ⊆ W, and let c, c' ∈ ℝ with |f(x)| ≤ c for every x and |ξ(x)(θ_L)| ≤ c' for μ-a.e. x. Write 𝓛ⁿ for Lebesgue measure (volume) on ℝⁿ. Assume (H1): there is C ∈ ℝ such that |T(φ)| ≤ C·M·(𝓛ⁿ(tsupport a))^{1/n} for every C^∞ compactly supported a : ℝⁿ → ℝ, every M ∈ ℝ with |a(y)| ≤ M for all y, and every φ ∈ Dⁿ(U) with φ(x) = (f(x)·a(L(x)))·θ_L for all x; here 𝓛ⁿ(tsupport a) is read as a real number (toReal) and 1/n = 1/((m : ℝ) + 1). Assume (H2): for every δ > 0 there is a C^∞ compactly supported b : ℝⁿ → ℝ with 0 ≤ b(y) ≤ 1 for all y, b(y) = 1 for all y ∈ L(K), and 𝓛ⁿ(tsupport b) ≤ δ (as a real number). Then every ζ ∈ Dⁿ(U) with ζ(x) = f(x)·θ_L for all x satisfies |T(ζ)| ≤ c·c'·μ(W∖K), with μ(W∖K) read as a real number (toReal).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U W K : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)), IsMeasureRepresentation T μ ξ → IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → IsCompact K → μ (W \ K) ≠ ∞ → ∀ (L : Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl (m + 1)) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (c c' : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ W → (∀ x, |f x| ≤ c) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, |ξ x (wedgeCovectors (m + 1) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.proj i : Eucl (m + 1) →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp L))| ≤ c') → (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ a : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) a → HasCompactSupport a → ∀ M : ℝ, (∀ y, |a y| ≤ M) → ∀ φ : TestFormOn U (m + 1), (∀ x, (φ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) x = (f x * a (L x)) • wedgeCovectors (m + 1) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.proj i : Eucl (m + 1) →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp L)) → |T φ| ≤ C * M * ((volume (tsupport a)).toReal) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / ((m : ℝ) + 1))) → (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ b : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) b ∧ HasCompactSupport b ∧ (∀ y, 0 ≤ b y ∧ b y ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ y ∈ L '' K, b y = 1) ∧ ((volume : Measure (Eucl (m + 1))) (tsupport b)).toReal ≤ δ) → ∀ ζ : TestFormOn U (m + 1), (∀ x, (ζ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) x = f x • wedgeCovectors (m + 1) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.proj i : Eucl (m + 1) →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp L)) → |T ζ| ≤ c * c' * (μ (W \ K)).toReal
